goal: Obtain three independent adversarial evaluations of the proposed agent-centered DispatchSpec before promoting its open questions into discovery.
context: The target is the proposed DispatchSpec model developed in the current conversation and grounded in the existing DispatchCandidate, domain specification, protocol discovery, and append-only subagent dispatch ledger. The review tests whether a dispatch envelope with a flat agent list, separate execution and communication graphs, agent-scoped initialization configuration, and dispatch-level completion is coherent and implementable. The three attackers receive the same evaluation instructions and work independently; repeated agreement is not treated as evidence without source verification. The target and sources are read-only, output is delivered inline, and no repository artifact may be modified.

Precisamos definir um DispatchSpec que represente um dispatch completo, seus agentes, configuracoes de inicializacao, dependencias de execucao, comunicacao autorizada, recursos, budgets e condicao de conclusao. A proposta procura se aproximar da estrutura observada em telemetry/agents/subagents-dispatch.yaml, eliminando groups como topologia autoritativa e representando diretamente agentes e relacoes.

PROPOSTA-DISPATCHSPEC-V0
O DispatchSpec e um envelope com duas topologias separadas: workflow.edges declara quem precisa terminar antes de quem; communication.channels declara quem pode enviar mensagens para quem. Separar os dois evita assumir que dependencia implica comunicacao.
